title: KestrelCare Rental Benefit Q&A: Counting the Rental Nights
content:
These answers set how the rental nights on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order are counted when the repair also passed through the Kestrel limited warranty. The limited warranty decision read is the holder's latest one, booked against the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order, with its decision, its rental days and its decision date.

**Rule.** The nights are counted as follows: where the latest limited warranty decision for the holder approved the same repair order and recorded rental days, the nights are those rental days; where that limited warranty decision recorded no approved rental days, the nights are counted in calendar days from the date of that limited warranty decision to the date of the plan's authorization; where the holder has no limited warranty decision, the nights are counted from the failure date to the date of the plan's authorization.

**The limited warranty decision is approved and shows 4 rental days. How many nights are counted?** Four — the rental days recorded on that decision.

**The limited warranty decision is approved but shows 0 rental days, or it is a denial. How are the nights counted?** As the calendar days from the limited warranty decision date to the date of the KestrelCare authorization; if the authorization is dated on or before the limited warranty decision date, the count is zero. Hypothetically, a limited warranty decision on 14 May and a KestrelCare authorization on 17 May give 3 nights.

**The holder has no limited warranty decision at all. What then?** The nights run in calendar days from the failure date to the date of the KestrelCare authorization; a failure date of 10 May with an authorization on 17 May gives 7 nights.

| Latest limited warranty decision | Nights counted |
|---|---|
| approved, rental days above 0 | those rental days |
| approved with 0 rental days, or denied | calendar days from its decision date to the KestrelCare authorization date |
| none | calendar days from the failure date to the KestrelCare authorization date |
